facts.fact: 章首：Nelveen 强行施法把她从垂死的 Gerrick 身边拽走——"我永远不会原谅你""我知道"
facts.anchor: A pull began in Andra’s midsection, sucking her back and away from Gerrick’s trembling body.

facts.fact: Nelveen 附魔使两人对兽群隐形——径直走向要塞大门；兽人在吞食同伙尸体
facts.anchor: The monsters blew past Andra, never stopping to question the women walking to the fortress gates.

facts.fact: 要塞走廊铁栏牢房：人/生物/家庭被折磨得意志尽毁——她循生命之源狂奔
facts.anchor: No, in those cells were people. Creatures. Families. Beings so brutally broken she couldn’t fathom

facts.fact: 圆塔密室：玻璃球内黑紫气体散去——翡翠悬于无形之力中（距冬至满月只剩一天）
facts.anchor: A glass orb floated just above it, with swirls of black and purple gas mixing with starlight within.

facts.fact: Vasara 首次现身：尖瘦利绿眼银发及腰——"我等你很久了"；Lucas/Rayner 被打得昏迷躺暗处
facts.anchor: Her voice was both entrancing and repulsive, reaching deep into Andra’s mind, and for a moment she couldn’t move

facts.fact: Bron 亮相（烧疤额角兽人）；她两度掌火被阴影掐灭——影缚椅受审；Vasara 嘲讽"你根本不是她女儿"
facts.anchor: I knew Cecilia, and you are no daughter of hers. Pathetic, really.

facts.fact: 血债宣言：母亲夺走力量/财富/爱——血债该偿我来收账
facts.anchor: “Your mother took everything from me. Power. Wealth. Love. There is a blood debt to be paid, and I’m ready to collect.”

facts.fact: 用刑：两英尺清单逐条宣读——Bron 折断十指打伤其他部位打爆鼻子
facts.anchor: “And have you been hiding in the Southern Woods for the last twenty-four years?” Vasara read.

facts.fact: 核弹反转：Cecilia 从未真正击败她——靠这颗翡翠隐忍百年；杀母者暗恋 Cecilia 崩溃供出继承人
facts.anchor: Vasara pulled the emerald from the neckline of her dress, where it hung from a long chain around her neck.

facts.fact: 章末：银柄人骨匕首（象牙骨刻符文泛绿光）——"取不到你母亲的力量但取得到你的""我一直在等你"
facts.anchor: we very much have access to yours,” she whispered into the space between them. “I’ve been waiting for you.
